cases.sentence: Разве этот человек не горящая головня, выхваченная из ___?
options: огонь
огня
огне
огнём
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Он показал мне первосвященника Иисуса, стоявшего перед ангелом Господнем, и сатану, стоявшего по правую руку от него, чтобы обвинять его.
reading.question: What scene is revealed to Zechariah in this vision?
options: Joshua the high priest standing before God's angel with Satan at his right to accuse him
Joshua leading an army against Satan's forces
Joshua entering the temple to offer sacrifices
Joshua being crowned as the new king
reading.correct: Joshua the high priest standing before God's angel with Satan at his right to accuse him
reading.explain: The vision shows 'первосвященника Иисуса, стоявшего перед ангелом Господнем, и сатану, стоявшего по правую руку от него, чтобы обвинять его' (Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him).

reading.ru: Господь сказал сатане, Господь да обличит тебя, сатана! Господь, избравший Иерусалим, да обличит тебя!
reading.question: How does God respond to Satan's accusations?
options: God rebukes Satan twice, saying 'The Lord rebukes you' and emphasizing His choice of Jerusalem
God argues with Satan about Joshua's character
God allows Satan to present evidence against Joshua
God removes Satan from the courtroom
reading.correct: God rebukes Satan twice, saying 'The Lord rebukes you' and emphasizing His choice of Jerusalem
reading.explain: God directly states 'Господь да обличит тебя, сатана!' twice, showing His authority and emphasizing His choice of Jerusalem.

reading.ru: Разве этот человек не горящая головня, выхваченная из огня? А Иисус, стоявший перед ангелом, был одет в грязную одежду.
reading.question: What is the condition of Joshua, and how does it contrast with his being saved?
options: He is like a burning stick snatched from the fire yet clothed in filthy garments
He is pure and righteous, ready for his duties
He is powerful and commands armies
He has been defeated and lost all authority
reading.correct: He is like a burning stick snatched from the fire yet clothed in filthy garments
reading.explain: God describes Joshua as 'горящая головня, выхваченная из огня' (a burning stick plucked from fire) despite being 'одет в грязную одежду' (clothed in filthy garments).

reading.ru: Смотри, я снял с тебя твой грех и одену тебя в праздничную одежду.
reading.question: What does the angel do for Joshua?
options: Remove his iniquity and clothe him in rich garments
Demand payment for his sins
Exile him for his transgressions
Require him to make restitution
reading.correct: Remove his iniquity and clothe him in rich garments
reading.explain: The angel declares 'я снял с тебя твой грех и одену тебя в праздничную одежду' (I have removed your iniquity and clothe you in festive garments).

reading.ru: Слушай, первосвященник Иисус, вместе со своими собратьями, сидящими перед тобой, прообразами будущего.
reading.question: What role do Joshua and his companions play?
options: They are signs or types of what is to come
They are judges over all Israel
They are warriors to defend the temple
They are priests forever without change
reading.correct: They are signs or types of what is to come
reading.explain: They are described as 'прообразами будущего' (signs/types of the future), indicating their significance in God's future plans.

reading.ru: Вот камень, который я положил перед Иисусом. На камне семь глаз. Я сделаю на нем надпись, возвещает Господь сил, и сниму грех этой земли в один день.
reading.question: What does God promise regarding the stone and the removal of sin?
options: He will remove the iniquity of the land in one day through an inscribed stone with seven eyes
The stone will become the foundation of the new temple
It will be used as a weapon against their enemies
It serves as a marker for a burial place
reading.correct: He will remove the iniquity of the land in one day through an inscribed stone with seven eyes
reading.explain: God says 'I will remove the iniquity of this land in one day' through an inscribed stone with seven eyes, symbolizing complete knowledge and oversight.
